newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kwong Yik says can survive on its own.
newsitem.headline: Kwong Yik says can survive on its own.

text.p: Malaysia's Kwong Yik Bank Bhd could survive outside the Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) group, Kwong Yik executive director Mohd Yusof Nassir said on Thursday.
Market rumours have speculated that Maybank, which owns a 75 percent stake in Kwong Yik, may be considering divesting all or part of its stake.

"It doesn't matter if Maybank wants to divest Kwong Yik or not," Yusof was quoted by the Bernama news agency as saying. "If we have to stand on our own, we will stand on our own," he told reporters after the bank's annual meeting.

Yusof also said that Kwong Yik would be venturing into the securities trading business by the end of 1996. He said the bank would do this by becoming an agent for Mayban Securities Sdn Bhd, Maybank's securities trading arm.
Kwong Yik is also planning to open 12 new branches, in addition to its existing 62-branch network, Yusof said.
